reuse.why: Calls the shared getCategoryIdsSkippedByMonthWideActions, getSheetValue('sum-amount-…'), setBudget and isTrackingBudget, and registers the handler with the same mutator(undoable(...)) wrapper; the category query and income check are copied rather than shared.

duplication.why: The body copies set3MonthAvg's scaffolding: the categories/category_groups SQL with its own hidden filters (which repeat what the skip helper already decides), the income/tracking check, the skip check and the batch loop.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts with its siblings and is exposed in budget/app.ts next to the other month-wide methods.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable and consistent with its neighbours, but it adds a sixth copy of the month-wide selection scaffolding, so a future change to which categories are filled has to be repeated here.
